selected_evidence.requirement: Keep installed curl at its current version during system updates
selected_evidence.summary: curl began at 7.47.0-1ubuntu2.19 without a hold. The hold was applied; APT and dpkg subsequently reported it, and upgrade simulations before and after restart showed zero curl install or upgrade actions.

Healthy baseline boot ID ac73b359-243e-418e-b7bb-a7cff423e597 was captured, the safe reboot was acknowledged, and node1 returned with changed boot ID 77e72301-52f9-420a-bbb8-078939df2645. Post-restart checks confirmed curl works, remains at 7.47.0-1ubuntu2.19, remains held, and the package database is clean.
